You are entering a fictional zone: reality has been suspended.
Mark's last day in the infohazard department is painfully predictable. In a world where magic and physical anomalies are contained by a secret organization, an ancient curse is item number three on the meeting agenda.
"SCP Dreams" by Issa Aqas

Director’s Statement:
Alien, Half-Life, Blade Runner, SCP Foundation... I'd love to visit those worlds but without grave danger or life-altering events. A bit of tension, sure, but it's just another night at the office.
